# Colleen Hoover
Colleen Hoover is the bestselling author of several books including her immensely popular novel, _It Ends with Us_ , that was adapted for the big screen in 2024.
The multiple Goodreads Choice Award winner is famous for her captivating romance books like _Ugly Love_ and _Reminders of Him_ , thrilling reads like _Verity_ and _Layla_ , and YA fiction. Known for her emotionally charged and thought–provoking narratives, Hoover has become a prominent voice in modern American literature.
